description: S07 operator definitions. Operator constants only — the P0/P1 experiment registry is S09's.

operator_version.note: Bumped whenever executable operator semantics change; it enters every merge artifact identity.

implemented_operators.note: 00 §10.1–§10.3. TIES (§10.4) and quantization (§10.5) are deferred and are refused by the factory rather than stubbed.

deferred_operators.note: Not implemented at S07. TIES may enter only under the §10.4 expansion rules.

descendant_counts.note: 00 §11. k = 8 is deferred and is added only if the k = 4 curve has not saturated.

deferred_descendant_counts.note: 00 §11 deferred value, declared so a family builder refuses it explicitly rather than by omission.

coefficient_policy.note: 00 §10.1. The generic operator does not clamp alpha to [0,1]; the registered coefficient schedule is S09's, not the operator's.

fixture_coefficients.note: Deterministic fixture coefficients for S07 operator tests only. Not a registered experiment schedule.

dare_candidate_drop_probabilities.note: 00 §24 candidate grid for the later utility sweep, with hard minimum p_min = 0.25. S07 implements a general validated p and selects none of these.

dare_minimum_drop_probability.note: 00 §24 p_min. If no p >= p_min passes the utility gate, DARE is removed from the main P1 axis.

dare_selected_drop_probability.note: p* = max{p : ΔNLL_p <= 0.05} [00 §24]. This is the outcome of a model-NLL utility gate that has NOT been run. Reading it fails closed, so no S07 code can select p*.

dare_mask_scheme.note: One merge-level DARE seed per descendant; the protected and partner masks are independent domain-separated substreams of it. Each per-tensor stream is keyed on (scheme, operator version, merge seed, constituent role, constituent content identity, tensor name, p). Reordering the same logical task vector cannot move a mask; the merge seed is materially included, and a task vector with a different tensor set is a different task vector and therefore has different masks.

fixture_dare_merge_seed.note: One deterministic merge-level DARE seed for S07 fixture tests. Real per-descendant merge seeds are registry values owned by S09. Constituent substreams are derived internally and are not caller-selectable.

svd_candidate_retained_ranks.note: 00 §10.3 candidate retained ranks against the primary LoRA rank r = 32. S07 implements a general positive rank and selects none of these.

svd_selected_retained_rank.note: s* is the outcome of the 00 §24A utility and non-triviality gates, which have NOT been run. Reading it fails closed, so no S07 code can select s*.

svd_backend.note: 01 §12. The CPU reference SVD is pinned so truncation is reproducible. Identity is taken over reconstructed matrices, never over U/V, which carry sign and degenerate-basis ambiguity.

svd_workspace_dtype.note: 01 §10. The SVD numerical workspace runs in float64 for stability; the resulting T_s matrix is deterministically cast to the arithmetic dtype before it is hashed or composed, so the scientific artifact bytes are float32.

arithmetic_dtype.note: 01 §10 merge/recovery arithmetic and 00 §25 P0-C1 ('compute in float32'). Every byte of a scientific merge artifact is float32; a float64 fixture result may never become a production result identity.

diagnostic_dtype.note: 01 §10 metrics/statistics: derived scalar quantities are stored in float64. Diagnostics accumulate norms and energies in float64 because they do not define the merged artifact bytes.

o3_status.note: 00 §10.3. O3 is pre-registered before P0-D so no replacement operator is chosen after seeing whether DARE succeeded. Implementation availability is not experiment authorization.

dare_gate_status.note: 00 §24. The utility gate is model NLL on real checkpoints and is not executed at S07.

o3_gate_status.note: 00 §24A. The utility and non-triviality gates are not executed at S07.

primary_lossy_operator.note: 00 §24A.7 sets P1_PRIMARY_LOSSY_OPERATOR only after both gates resolve. Reading it fails closed, so no S07 code can name a primary lossy operator.
